scope: Paired eight-accumulator native BF16 candidate; local read-only analysis of saved compiler output.
method: Parse non-local disassembly function boundaries; read actual positive paddxm stack adjustments; follow direct jl calls; combine with ELF _sp_start_value_DM_stack and A-buffer symbols and address-assigned MLIR. Local labels do not end function bodies.
limitations: Representative cores (0,2) and (1,2) per stage have disassembly; all archived core ELF stack/A addresses are checked.
Does not count device cycles or certify absence of any unrelated memory fault.
The .stack_sizes section omits worker frames and is not sufficient for nested stack safety.
